A1.justification: Both readable PDFs describe Know3D, with matching methods and main experiments. v1 includes Appendices A–C; v2 ends after the complete reference list. The omitted appendix material can be reliably distinguished from relocated content.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation experiments, HY3D-Bench comparisons, timestep and feature ablations, and geometry evaluations in Tables 1–4 and accompanying figures.

after.justification: v2 retains original HY3D-Bench results, controlled-generation examples, and timestep and feature ablations in Tables 1–3 and Figures 1–7.

M1.justification: Qwen-Image-Edit fine-tuning, MMDiT hidden-state conditioning, parallel cross-attention injection, and two-stage TRELLIS.2 generation remain unchanged. The disappearance of implementation specifics from Appendix A does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use TexVerse for training and held-out ablations, and HY3D-Bench for evaluation. The omitted appendix experiments and examples concern the same 3D generation and back-view control tasks.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same seven baselines. However, v2 removes the separate geometry comparison against TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D-2mv in Table 4, plus the additional Hunyuan3D-2mv comparison in Figure 8.

E3.justification: v2 omits the additional HY3D-Bench geometry/backside-normal evaluation using PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and Chamfer Distance. Settings for retained experiments, including rendering procedures, splits, and ablation training budgets, remain unchanged. Missing appendix hyperparameters represent reduced documentation.

E4.justification: The timestep and feature ablations, including Figure 7's analysis of erroneous back-view guidance, remain unchanged. v2 removes the explicit instruction-following failure case in Figure 9 and additional qualitative control case studies in Appendix B.2.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed lists, repeated-run counts, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The retained results use the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: v2 removes the complete geometry/backside-normal result set in Table 4, including test Chamfer distances of 0.0574 for Know3D, 0.0635 for TRELLIS.2, and 0.0637 for Hunyuan3D-2mv. Qualitative results in Figures 8–11 also disappear. Tables 1–3 retain identical values and rankings.

T1.justification: The conditioning definitions, flow-matching objectives, residual fusion, and two-stage generation equations remain identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: transferring multimodal knowledge through diffusion hidden states, enabling language-controlled back-view generation, and improving structural plausibility. The core claims are neither expanded nor narrowed.

C2.justification: v2 removes Appendix B.1's interpretation that geometry and normal-map scores demonstrate more accurate surface details and better perceptual quality. Section 5 retains the limitation that misunderstood instructions can produce incorrect shapes, despite removal of its illustrated failure case.

D1.justification: Removing Appendix A eliminates learning rates of 1e-4, the 20k image-training schedule, explicit 64/512 stage resolutions, selection of MMDiT blocks 20/30/40, and the full two-stage 70k training disclosure. Main-text hardware, batch sizes, LoRA ranks, and the first-stage ablation budget remain.

R1.justification: The same 72 references and related-work positioning are retained. No cited research or substantive novelty relationship is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 updates affiliations and author headers, adds funding acknowledgements and a Figure 3 pointer, and removes the appendix sections. The retained scientific narrative and main section order are essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 removes the supplemental geometry table and the comparison, failure, and control displays in Figures 8–11. Retained tables and figures are redistributed, including a dedicated page for Figure 4. Figure 2's annotation arrows receive a small redraw.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the main method and scores but removes the full-mesh geometry/backside-normal quantitative comparison, important reproduction settings, and illustrated failure evidence. Together these omissions substantially weaken empirical support for geometric quality and reproducibility. The retained written limitation and small editorial and diagram refinements do not compensate for those losses.
